name: Data Migration
description: Rust library behind the Data Migration tab: re-exports the four wireless-coordination importers (IAS, Soundbase, Wireless Workbench, CSV — each owned by its DATATYPE.wireless.* repository) for oaRustCore, carries the JSON data editor, and holds the frame-headers contract test. No page of its own: the tab's frames post each file as a job to its wireless_* worker.
